Game Information

Chapter one of the Hoopz Barkley SaGa (Tales of Game's, 2008), lovingly brought back for a new generation through a combination of Generative AI and weaponised Autism.
Arrow keys move, Z is action/confirm, X is cancel, C opens the menu.

  • GamePad support that doesn't require you using Joy2Key (I really did this shit back in the day so I could play this game with a Wiimote)
  • AspieVision™ Precise Pixel Rendering
  • Hyper-Realistic Voice Acting
